en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīya (2), Tikadukapaṭṭhānapāḷi (4) 10.7.
Kusala-ttika, Mahantara-duka.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor has an object... (Abbreviated. Nine under root condition ... pe ... nine under non-disappearance condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor has a different object... (Abbreviated. Twenty-four under root condition ... pe ... nine under resultant condition ... pe ... twenty-four under non-disappearance condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor is consciousness... (Abbreviated; the phrase "nor is mental" [nanocittapada] is not obtained. Twenty-nine under root condition, twenty-four under object condition ... pe ... nine under resultant condition ... pe ... twenty-nine under non-disappearance condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor mental … (Abbreviated. Under root-condition there are eighteen;
under object-condition nine … pe … under resultant-condition nine … pe … under non-disappearance-condition there are eighteen.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor associated with consciousness … pe … dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor conjoined with consciousness … pe … dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor generated by consciousness … (Abbreviated.)
With respect to root-cause: nine … pe … with respect to non-disappearance: nine.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor conascent with consciousness … (Abbreviated.
With respect to root-cause: eighteen; with respect to object: nine … pe … with respect to resultant: nine … pe … with respect to non-disappearance: eighteen.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor concomitant with the mind … dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor conjoined with and produced by the mind … dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor conjoined with, produced by,
and co-existent with the mind … dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor conjoined with, produced by, and concomitant with the mind … (Abbreviated.)
With respect to the root condition, there are eighteen; with respect to the object condition, nine ... pe ... with respect to the result condition, nine ... pe ...

with respect to the non-disappearance condition, eighteen. Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor internal ... (Abbreviated. With respect to the root condition, there are twenty-nine; with respect to the object condition, twenty-four ... pe ... with respect to the result condition, nine ... pe ...

with respect to the non-disappearance condition, twenty-nine. Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor external ... (Abbreviated. With respect to the root condition, there are nine ... pe ... with respect to the non-disappearance condition, nine.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor acquired (*na-kusalaṃ na-upādā*), [arises a state] … (Abbreviated.

Under the root condition (*hetu*) there are twenty-nine; under the object condition (*ārammaṇa*) there are twenty-four … pe … under the result condition (*vipāka*) there are nine … pe … under the non-disappearance condition (*avigata*) there are twenty-nine.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor clung-to (*na-kusalaṃ na-upādinnam*), [arises a state] … (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are twenty-nine; under the object condition there are twenty-four … pe … under the result condition there are nine … pe … under the non-disappearance condition there are twenty-nine.
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor acquired by clinging … (Abbreviated. Nine in the case of root … pe … nine in the case of non-disappearance.
